note: Hypothetical requirement changes for demonstrating change impact. None of these has been announced by FIFA; each changes one criterion of a catalogue requirement so its effect on existing evidence can be shown.

scenarios.title: Brighter pitch for 8K broadcast
scenarios.summary: Average vertical illuminance towards the fixed cameras rises from above 1,500 lux to above 2,000 lux.

scenarios.title: More even vertical lighting
scenarios.summary: Vertical uniformity U1 tightens from above 0.5 to above 0.6.

scenarios.title: Larger semi-final stadiums
scenarios.summary: Seating for semi-final venues rises from at least 60,000 to at least 65,000.
